newsitem.title: USA: Picturetel sees Q1 earnings off from Q4.
newsitem.headline: Picturetel sees Q1 earnings off from Q4.

text.p: PictureTel Corp Wednesday said it expects "slightly" lower sales and lower earnings in the first quarter of 1997 than in the fourth quarter of 1996.
The company said it expects good overall earnings and revenue growth in 1997, but at a slower rate than in previous years.
Earlier, the company said fourth quarter 1996 revenues rose to to $140.1 million, as compared to $102.0 million for the corresponding quarter of 1995.
Revenues for the year rose 39 percent to $482.5 million, for the year ended December 31, 1996, compared to 1995.
Net income for 1996 rose 77 percent to a record $34.8 million, or $0.96 per share, compared to $19.6 million, or $0.56 per share for 1995.
In the fourth quarter, net income rose 38 percent to a record $9.9 million, or $0.28 per share, compared to $7.2 million, or $0.20 per share, for the fourth quarter of 1995.
